result.summary: Several visual layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names, a loading spinner covering content, and cut-off cards at the edges of horizontal carousels.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, use a smaller font, or ensure cards have enough width/ellipsis with full name on tap

issues.description: A large loading spinner is overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar promo image, obscuring the food photo
issues.suggestion: Hide or remove the spinner once content has loaded, or show a proper skeleton/placeholder instead of blocking the image

issues.description: Horizontal restaurant cards are clipped at the right edge (third card only partially visible)
issues.suggestion: Add consistent peek/padding so partial cards clearly indicate scrollability without cutting off important content awkwardly

issues.description: Bottom pizza card and category chips appear cut off by the screen edge
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal lists and bottom content have adequate end padding so UI elements are not hard-clipped

issues.description: Category filter row ends with a partially visible empty/white chip on the right
issues.suggestion: Hide overflow chips cleanly or show a clear scroll affordance without a broken partial pill
